Chapter 575: Chapter 18: Fear of the Demigod (Subscription Requested)_2

Lin Yuan, if he unleashed too powerful strength, he would be detected by the Goddess of the Magic Web.

The Goddess of the Magic Web is one of the twenty-four Prime Gods, at the Ninth Stage Peak, nearing the strength of the Tenth Rank. Before restoring to his peak, Lin Yuan was reluctant to attract the attention of such a powerful being.

Furthermore,

Once the Goddess of the Magic Web became aware, the other twenty-three Prime Gods would definitely also know.

The twenty-four Prime Gods of this realm, although divided into the Ocean of Light and the Black Abyss camps, all stand from the perspective of the gods and could completely join forces when necessary.

…

...

Deepest hall.

The emissary of the Lust Church gathered together with several bishops.

“The youngest son of the lord of Anpu City has been completely controlled by us. As long as we deal with the few heirs ahead of him, the entire Anpu City will become the garden of our church.”

“There is also the fifth in line of succession from Viscount Qingluan. He’s also under our control. Within at most two hundred years, the fifty million li domain of Viscount Qingluan will belong to our church…”

“Two hundred years ago, those mad dogs from the Rank Church drove us from the most prosperous capital to this place. One day, we will return, and our god will ascend the divine throne, becoming one of the eternal stars above the sky…”

…

The voices of the bishops of the Lust Church were uplifting, all possessing the strength of Sixth Rank Legendary Knights, the core strength of the church.

Over the years, the Lust Church had taken root in Anpu City, and its influence had only grown, which was evident to the bishops.

Although Anpu City is far less prosperous and religiously diverse than the capital, it is much safer.

In the capital, within the territory of the Rank Church, the Lust Church was like a rat crossing the street, constantly on the brink of being besieged with little carelessness.

In Anpu City, however, it is much safer as long as they are cautious and don’t act directly, making it difficult to attract the attention of the Rank Church.

“It’s a pity that we didn’t smoothly take down Longshan Ling a hundred years ago; otherwise, Anpu City and many surrounding domains would now belong to our Lust Church…”

A bishop sighed.

The initial target of the Lust Church fleeing to Anpu City was indeed Longshan Ling.

The Lust Church spared no effort to control the fourth heir of the Longshan Family. If they could have dealt with Longshan Yuan and caused his accidental death at that time,

In just a few decades, they would have been able to control the entire Longshan Ling.

Then with the power of Longshan Ling, they could have influenced the surrounding viscount territories, and Anpu City could not have resisted.

Unfortunately,

Longshan Yuan, that willful scion, unexpectedly turned to become a knight genius of the Longshan Family, causing the early investments of the Lust Church to be wasted.

A slow start led to continuous delays, and later, the Lust Church, unwilling to yield, specifically set aside efforts to try to win back Longshan Yuan.

But still with no avail.

If it weren’t for that Longshan Yuan, with the strength of the Lust Church, which could have stirred a storm in the capital, how could it have spent nearly two hundred years without fully mastering Anpu City?

“That Longshan Yuan, blocking the footsteps of my god, should die. When the glory of my god covers Longshan Ling, Longshan Yuan will beg for life and beg for death.”

A bishop spoke.

The emissary standing under the statue glanced at the several bishops below and said nothing more.

She also extremely despised Longshan Yuan for delaying the precious development time of the church.

Just then,

The deepest hall suddenly began to tremble.

Waves of pink divine power began to boil, trying to protect the few people inside the hall.

However, under the crushing of an unknown power, all the pink divine power began to evaporate rapidly.

“What’s going on?”

“Did my god’s divine power barrier automatically activate?”

“Did we just get attacked?”

The bishops were shocked, and the normally calm emissary was also in disbelief.

This deepest hall was a stronghold of the Lust Church, a place enveloped by the power of the Mother Goddess of Lust. Even if faced with an attack by a group of demigods, blocking it for a short time was not a problem.

The Mother Goddess of Lust, even among other demigods, was undoubtedly a formidable figure.

However now, in just a moment, six-tenths of all the pink divine power was evaporated, which was terrifying.

“Hm?”

“Did all the congregation of the church perish?”

The emissary, clad in black gauze, seemed to have realized something as her expression drastically changed once again.

As an emissary of the church, she could feel the life fluctuations of all church members, even sensing the faith power they generated.

So when everyone in the luxurious palace died at a mere thought from Lin Yuan, she instantly sensed it.

“How is that possible?”

The emissary was astoundingly perplexed; the congregation in the luxurious palace was over a hundred thousand strong, including many Fourth and Fifth Level Knights. Even facing the siege of the Rank Church, they would die one by one, not simultaneously. What is this situation?

Thunderous sounds echoed.

Just then.

The large door in this area suddenly burst open.

A short, stout man slowly walked in.

“Who?”

“Who in the end is it?”

Several bishops were both shocked and furious, staring at Lin Yuan, but the next moment their heads exploded without any warning, strong as Sixth Rank legendary figures, yet they possessed not a trace of resistance.

“Respected Demigod, may I ask what brings you here…”

The divine envoy clad in black veils composed herself and immediately spoke with respectful demeanor.

Being able to burst in so easily and slaughter Sixth Rank legendary bishops as if slaughtering chickens, only a Demigod of the same tier as the Mother Goddess of Lust could accomplish this.

Moreover, not just any ordinary Demigod, but at least one as powerful as the Mother Goddess of Lust herself.

Facing such a powerful figure, even the Prime Gods of the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss had to manifest their divine powers to suppress, let alone others.

“Where is your church’s god?” Lin Yuan scanned his surroundings as he asked directly.

His action was intended to resolve the threat of the Lust Church, and to completely annihilate the Lust Church, he had to kill the Mother Goddess of Lust that backed it.

If the Mother Goddess of Lust did not die, the Lust Church could be rebuilt at any time.

“I do not know the whereabouts of my god…” The divine envoy in black veils was slightly stunned before she continued, “However, if your Highness wishes to meet my god, I can make contact for you…”

“No need.”

“Too much trouble.”

Lin Yuan looked at the divine envoy in black veils, his thoughts shifted slightly, and her head likewise exploded.

“Causality…”

Lin Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly, tracing the obscure threads of causality to roughly lock onto the location of the Mother Goddess of Lust.

Lin Yuan had decimated the Lust Church and slain many followers of the Mother Goddess of Lust. Although he had never directly interacted with the Mother Goddess of Lust, a tie of causality had also formed between them.

Utilizing this thread of causality, Lin Yuan could faintly pinpoint the location of the Mother Goddess of Lust.

…

In a place millions of miles away from the Plateau of Myriad Nations.

A woman dressed in a pink skirt hem was en route to the Plateau of Myriad Nations, but suddenly stopped.

“Who in the end is slaughtering my followers?”

This woman was precisely the Mother Goddess of Lust. As a Demigod, unless surrounded by a True God’s divine incarnation, she could roam without fear.

“My hard-earned followers…” The Mother Goddess of Lust lamented inside; those incredibly devout followers were not easy to cultivate.

She could sense that the church stronghold in Anpu City had been virtually wiped out.

“I must see who laid their hands on them.”

The Mother Goddess of Lust followed a certain connection, receiving the final images her followers saw before their death.

This was also a power developed after establishing a faith connection; a deity possessed everything of their followers, and could easily access memories and more.

Bang, bang, bang.

The Mother Goddess of Lust furrowed her brows slightly.

In just a few breaths, she saw many images of her followers just before they died, discovering that they had died without even seeing their enemy.

“Hmm?”

The Mother Goddess of Lust immediately checked the final memory of the divine envoy.

To become a divine envoy of the Lust Church certainly meant being highly in tune with the Mother Goddess of Lust, and in crucial moments, even becoming a vessel incarnation for the Mother Goddess of Lust.

Whoosh.

The Mother Goddess of Lust watched the memory images of the divine envoy.

Seeing the core hall trembling, her expression turned solemn.

Anyone capable of shaking her core hall setting must also be a powerful Demigod.

Finally, in the divine envoy’s perspective, a short, stout man walked in.

Subsequently, several Sixth Rank bishops died, and after the stout man asked a few questions to the divine envoy, the envoy also died.

“This method of elimination?”

The Mother Goddess of Lust widened her eyes. Through the divine envoy’s perspective, she finally saw the short stout man making the move, several dead Sixth Rank bishops, and the subsequently dead divine envoy…

“Divine Kingdom power!”

“This is Divine Kingdom power!”

“This person is not a Demigod, but a True God!”

“No, wait, a True God cannot descend to the mortal realm; is he a Prime God, overseeing all life and gods?”

The Mother Goddess of Lust was terrified to her core; her movements toward the Plateau of Myriad Nations immediately reversed, fleeing frantically away from the Plateau of Myriad Nations.
